subject: english
question:
连词成句。

was, built, the, bridge, in, 2010

________________________________________
answer: The bridge was built in 2010.
analysis:
【考点】考查被动语态语序
【解题思路】主语The bridge + 被动结构was built + 时间状语in 2010
【解题口诀】👉 被动语态找be+done
core_trap: 学生容易把被动语态排成主动语序
mnemonic: 连词成句先找主谓宾

subject: english
question:
连词成句。

told, me, he, would, come, the, he, next, day

________________________________________
answer: He told me he would come the next day.
analysis:
【考点】考查宾语从句语序+间接引语时间词变化
【解题思路】主句He told me + 宾语从句he would come the next day。直接引语变间接引语时，tomorrow须改为the next day，will改为would。
【解题口诀】👉 宾语从句陈述语序，间接引语时间词要变：tomorrow→the next day
core_trap: 学生容易忘记把tomorrow改成the next day，或忘记will退为would
mnemonic: 主过从必过，时间词也要变：today→that day, tomorrow→the next day

subject: english
question:
连词成句。

has, lived, she, in, Beijing, since, 2018

________________________________________
answer: She has lived in Beijing since 2018.
analysis:
【考点】考查现在完成时+since的用法
【解题思路】主语She + has lived + 地点状语in Beijing + 时间状语since 2018
【解题口诀】👉 现在完成时搭配since/for表示一段时间
core_trap: 学生容易把has lived写成lived，忽略完成时态
mnemonic: since/for出现，现在完成时相伴

subject: english
question:
连词成句。

it, if, rains, tomorrow, we, will, stay, at, home

________________________________________
answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
analysis:
【考点】考查条件状语从句「主将从现」
【解题思路】if引导条件状语从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时
【解题口诀】👉 主将从现：主句将来时，从句现在时
core_trap: 学生容易把从句也写成will rain，违反「主将从现」规则
mnemonic: 主将从现要牢记，if从句用现在

subject: english
question:
连词成句。

what, a, beautiful, park, it, is

________________________________________
answer: What a beautiful park it is!
analysis:
【考点】考查what引导的感叹句
【解题思路】What + a + 形容词 + 名词(单数) + 主语 + 谓语！
【解题口诀】👉 What + a/an + adj. + n. + 主谓！
core_trap: 学生容易混淆what和how的用法
mnemonic: what后面接名词，how后面接形容词

subject: english
question:
连词成句。

not, only, but, also, he, is, clever, hard-working

________________________________________
answer: He is not only clever but also hard-working.
analysis:
【考点】考查not only...but also...并列连词
【解题思路】主语He + is + not only + adj.1 + but also + adj.2
【解题口诀】👉 not only...but also连接两个并列成分
core_trap: 学生容易漏掉also或把also放在but前面
mnemonic: 不但而且两边连，also跟在but后面

subject: english
question:
连词成句。

asked, the, teacher, us, to, read, the, book

________________________________________
answer: The teacher asked us to read the book.
analysis:
【考点】考查ask sb. to do sth.结构
【解题思路】主语The teacher + asked + 宾语us + to do + 宾语the book
【解题口诀】👉 ask sb. to do sth. 是固定搭配
core_trap: 学生容易写成asked us reading，把不定式写成doing
mnemonic: ask后面接to do，不带to就错了

subject: english
question:
连词成句。

enough, the, boy, is, to, go, old, to, school

________________________________________
answer: The boy is old enough to go to school.
analysis:
【考点】考查adj. + enough + to do sth.结构
【解题思路】主语The boy + is + old enough + to go to school
【解题口诀】👉 enough放在形容词后面，to do紧跟其后
core_trap: 学生容易把enough放在old前面，写成enough old
mnemonic: enough放adj.后面，to do紧跟上

subject: english
question:
连词成句。

it, is, important, for, us, to, learn, English, well

________________________________________
answer: It is important for us to learn English well.
analysis:
【考点】考查It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.句型
【解题思路】It是形式主语，真正的主语是to learn English well。for us引出逻辑主语。这是八年级核心句型，在书面表达中使用频率极高。
【解题口诀】👉 It is + adj. + for sb. + to do，it是假主语，to do才是真主语
core_trap: 学生容易漏掉for，写成It is important us to learn，或漏掉it，直接写成To learn English is important for us（语法没错但不是考试标准答案）
mnemonic: It is adj for sb to do，for sb别忘记，to do是真正主语

subject: english
question:
连词成句。

was, doing, my, homework, I, when, my, mother, came, back

________________________________________
answer: I was doing my homework when my mother came back.
analysis:
【考点】考查when引导的时间状语从句（过去进行时）
【解题思路】主句用过去进行时I was doing homework，从句用一般过去时when my mother came back
【解题口诀】👉 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻正在做某事
core_trap: 学生容易把主句也写成一般过去时，忽略过去进行时
mnemonic: when出现看时态，过去进行配一般过去

subject: english
question:
根据中文提示完成句子（每空一词）。

这个男孩太小了，不能上学。
The boy is _________ young _________ go to school.
answer: too; to
analysis:
【考点】考查too...to...（太……以至于不能……）结构
【解题思路】too + adj./adv. + to do sth.，表示太……以至于不能做某事。注意to是不定式符号，后面接动词原形，不是介词。
【解题口诀】👉 too...to...等于so...that...can't...，两者可以互相转换
core_trap: 学生容易在to后面加not（too...to...本身已含否定意义，不能再加not），或与so...that...混淆
mnemonic: too to自带否定，后面绝不再加not

subject: english
question:
根据中文提示完成句子（每空一词）。

他过去常常放学后打篮球，但现在他不打了。
He _________ _________ play basketball after school, but now he doesn't.
answer: used to
analysis:
【考点】考查used to do sth.（过去常常做某事）结构
【解题思路】used to do表示过去常常做某事（现在已经不做了），后面接动词原形。注意与be used to doing（习惯于做某事）和be used to do（被用来做某事）区分。
【解题口诀】👉 used to do过去常做，be used to doing现在习惯，be used to do被动用途
core_trap: 学生容易混淆used to do（过去常常）和be used to doing（习惯于），后者要加ing
mnemonic: used to do是过去的事，to后面原形不动；be used to doing是习惯的事，to后面ing紧跟

subject: english
question:
根据中文提示完成句子（每空一词）。

这部电影太有趣了，以至于我想再看一遍。
The movie was _________ interesting _________ I want to watch it again.
answer: so; that
analysis:
【考点】考查so...that...（如此……以至于……）结果状语从句
【解题思路】so + adj./adv. + that从句。so修饰形容词interesting，that引导结果状语从句。注意区分so...that...（接从句）和so...as to...（接不定式）。
【解题口诀】👉 so adj/adv that从句，that后面是完整句子
core_trap: 学生容易在that后面加to，写成that to watch（错误），that引导的是从句不是不定式
mnemonic: so that后面跟从句，从句主谓要完整

subject: english
question:
根据中文提示完成句子（每空一词）。

直到他告诉我，我才知道这件事。
I _________ know anything about it _________ he told me.
answer: didn't; until
analysis:
【考点】考查not...until...（直到……才……）结构
【解题思路】not...until...表示直到……才……。主句用否定（didn't know），until引导的时间状语从句用肯定。这是八年级高频考点。
【解题口诀】👉 not...until...主句否定until肯定，意思是直到...才...
core_trap: 学生容易在until前面用肯定，写成I knew...until...，意思完全相反
mnemonic: not until才出现，until前面必否定

subject: english
question:
根据中文提示完成句子（每空一词）。

老师要求我们每天读英语。
The teacher asked us _________ _________ English every day.
answer: to read
analysis:
【考点】考查ask sb. to do sth.（要求某人做某事）结构
【解题思路】ask sb. to do sth.是固定搭配，to是不定式符号，后面接动词原形。同类结构还有tell sb. to do, want sb. to do, invite sb. to do等。
【解题口诀】👉 ask/tell/want sb. to do sth.，to do固定不变
core_trap: 学生容易写成ask us reading（加了ing），不定式to后面必须是动词原形
mnemonic: ask后to do不能变，reading doing靠边站

subject: english
answer:
Dear Tom,

I am so glad to hear that you are coming to my city next weekend. I would like to invite you to my birthday party.

The party will be held at my home at 6:00 p.m. next Saturday. We will have a big dinner with lots of delicious food. After that, we can play games, sing songs, and watch a movie together. It will be a wonderful evening!

I hope you can come. I am looking forward to seeing you.

Yours,
Li Ming
analysis:
【考点】考查邀请信格式和内容
【解题思路】称呼→表达喜悦→说明聚会时间地点→介绍活动→期待对方到来→落款
【解题口诀】👉 书信格式：称呼顶格写，正文缩进写，落款右下角
core_trap: 学生容易忘记书信格式，或者内容不完整，缺少时间或地点
mnemonic: 邀请信五要素：时间、地点、活动、原因、期待

subject: english
answer:
Dear Miss Li,

I am writing to thank you for your help with my English last week.

I was very worried about my English exam because I could not understand some grammar rules. You spent your free time explaining them to me patiently. You also gave me some useful tips on how to remember new words. With your help, I did well in the exam.

Thank you so much. I will work harder in the future.

Yours,
Wang Hua
analysis:
【考点】考查感谢信格式和具体感谢内容
【解题思路】直接表达感谢→具体说明对方的帮助→描述结果→再次感谢→落款
【解题口诀】👉 感谢信要具体：说了什么感谢内容，不要太空泛
core_trap: 学生容易写得太笼统，没有具体说明老师帮了什么
mnemonic: 感谢信不空泛，具体事例来支撑

subject: english
answer:
Dear Peter,

I am sorry to hear that you are feeling stressed about your exams. Here is some advice that may help you.

First, you should make a study plan and review your lessons regularly. Second, it is important to take a break and do some exercise, such as running or playing basketball. Third, you had better talk to your parents or teachers when you feel too stressed. They can always help you.

I hope you will feel better soon. Good luck with your exams!

Yours,
Zhang Wei
analysis:
【考点】考查建议信和提建议的句型
【解题思路】表达关心→用First/Second/Third分条给出建议→鼓励结尾→落款
【解题口诀】👉 提建议三大利器：should/had better/it is important to
core_trap: 学生建议不够具体，或者句型单一
mnemonic: 建议信条理清，First Second Third来帮忙

subject: english
answer:
Dear Jack,

Thank you for your email. I am happy to tell you about the Chinese New Year.

Before the festival, we clean our houses and put up red couplets. On New Year Eve, families get together and have a big dinner. We eat dumplings and watch the Spring Festival Gala on TV. Children love this festival because they can get red packets with lucky money from their parents and grandparents. We also visit relatives and friends during the holiday.

Welcome to China to experience it yourself one day!

Best wishes,
Liu Fang
analysis:
【考点】考查传统文化介绍+邮件格式
【解题思路】开头回应→介绍节前准备→介绍除夕活动→介绍春节习俗→邀请体验
【解题口诀】👉 介绍节日抓习俗：before/during/after分阶段写
core_trap: 学生容易只罗列习俗，没有合理组织时间顺序
mnemonic: 介绍节日分阶段，before/after有条理

subject: english
answer:
Dear Li Lei,

I am writing to say sorry to you. I borrowed your English book last week, but I am afraid I have lost it. I am very sorry about that.

I have looked for it everywhere, but I still cannot find it. I will buy a new one for you and give it to you next Monday. I hope you can forgive me. I promise I will be more careful next time.

Sorry again for the trouble.

Yours,
Chen Jie
analysis:
【考点】考查道歉信格式
【解题思路】直接道歉→说明事情经过→描述补救措施→请求原谅→再次道歉
【解题口诀】👉 道歉信三步：说sorry→说原因→说补偿
core_trap: 学生容易只说sorry没有补偿方案
mnemonic: 道歉不能只说sorry，补偿方案更诚意

subject: english
answer:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am Zhao Min from Class 3, Grade 8. I am writing to apply for the English speech contest.

I want to join the contest because I love English very much and I want to improve my spoken English. I have been learning English for five years and I can speak it fluently. I also won first prize in our school English competition last year. I believe I can do a good job this time.

I would appreciate it if you could give me this chance. Thank you for your consideration.

Yours,
Zhao Min
analysis:
【考点】考查申请信格式和个人优势表达
【解题思路】自我介绍→申请理由→展示优势→表达感谢→落款
【解题口诀】👉 申请信要展示：why me + what I can do
core_trap: 学生容易只说想参加，不说明自己的优势
mnemonic: 申请信说理由，更要展示自身实力

subject: english
answer:
Dear Xiaomei,

How is everything going? I have some problems and I need your help.

I will go to a new school next month and I feel very nervous. I am worried that I will not make new friends there. I am also afraid that the lessons will be too difficult for me. I really miss our old school and all our classmates.

Can you give me some advice? How can I make new friends quickly? I am looking forward to hearing from you.

Yours,
Sun Li
analysis:
【考点】考查求助信格式和情感表达
【解题思路】问候→说明困难→描述具体担忧→请求帮助→期待回复
【解题口诀】👉 求助信先说困扰，再求建议，最后期待回复
core_trap: 学生容易写得太笼统，没有具体的担忧内容
mnemonic: 求助信要说清，具体困难写明白

subject: english
answer:
NOTICE

Boys and girls,

In order to improve our spoken English and provide a chance for students to show themselves, our school will hold an English speech contest next Friday.

The contest will begin at 2:00 p.m. in the school hall. The topic is "My Dream". Each contestant will have 3-5 minutes to give a speech. If you want to take part in it, please sign up at the Students' Union office before this Wednesday.

Everyone is welcome to join. We are looking forward to your wonderful performance!

Students' Union
April 15, 2026
analysis:
【考点】考查通知格式和要点
【解题思路】标题NOTICE居中→称呼→活动目的（In order to...）→时间地点→参加方式→注意事项→落款+日期
【解题口诀】👉 通知五要素：目的、时间、地点、对象、方式，落款在右下角日期在最后
core_trap: 学生容易忘记NOTICE标题居中大写，或落款格式错误（应为组织名称+日期）
mnemonic: NOTICE大写居中，落款右下角，日期最后写

subject: english
question:
书面表达：话题写作。

请以「My Dream Job」为题，写一篇短文。

要求：
1. 80-120词
2. 包括你想做什么职业、为什么想做、打算怎么做
3. 语句通顺，意思连贯
answer:
My Dream Job

Everyone has a dream job. My dream is to be a doctor when I grow up.

There are several reasons why I want to be a doctor. First, doctors can help sick people and save lives. I think it is a great and meaningful job. Second, my mother is a nurse and she often tells me interesting stories about her work in the hospital. She is my hero.

To achieve my dream, I will study hard, especially in science and biology. I will also read more books about medicine. I believe that if I work hard enough, my dream will come true one day.
analysis:
【考点】考查话题写作+职业话题
【解题思路】开篇点题→说明原因（用First/Second组织）→说明行动计划→结尾激励
【解题口诀】👉 话题作文结构：what（是什么）+ why（为什么）+ how（怎么做）
core_trap: 学生容易只写是什么，忽略为什么和怎么做
mnemonic: 话题作文三段式：what why how 齐上场

subject: english
question:
书面表达：话题写作。

请以「How to Keep Healthy」为题，写一篇短文。

要求：
1. 80-120词
2. 包括至少3条保持健康的方法
3. 语句通顺，意思连贯
answer:
How to Keep Healthy

Health is the most important thing in our life. Here are some ways to keep healthy.

First, we should eat a balanced diet. We need to eat more vegetables and fruits, and eat less junk food. Second, we should do exercise every day, such as running, swimming, or playing basketball. Exercise can make our bodies strong. Third, we should get enough sleep. Teenagers need at least eight hours of sleep every night. Finally, we should keep a good mood and smile more often.

In a word, if we follow these tips, we will live a healthy and happy life.
analysis:
【考点】考查健康话题写作+提建议句型
【解题思路】引出话题→用First/Second/Third分条说明→总结
【解题口诀】👉 话题作文加分项：First/Second/Third/Finally条理清晰
core_trap: 学生建议太少或没有逻辑顺序
mnemonic: 列举建议用连词，条理清晰得分高

subject: english
question:
书面表达：话题写作。

请以「My Hometown」为题，写一篇短文介绍你的家乡。

要求：
1. 80-120词
2. 包括家乡的位置、特点、美食和你的感受
3. 语句通顺，意思连贯
answer:
My Hometown

My hometown is a beautiful city in the south of China. It is not very big, but it is clean and quiet.

The weather here is warm all year round, so we can see flowers and green trees everywhere. There are many interesting places to visit, such as the old park and the museum by the river. The food in my hometown is very delicious. The most famous food is hot pot, and many tourists come here to try it.

I love my hometown very much because it is a wonderful place to live. Welcome to my hometown!
analysis:
【考点】考查家乡介绍类写作
【解题思路】总体介绍（位置/大小）→自然环境和景点→特色美食→表达感情+欢迎
【解题口诀】👉 家乡介绍四要素：位置、环境、美食、感情
core_trap: 学生容易写成流水账，缺少特色描写
mnemonic: 介绍家乡抓特色，别人才会有印象

subject: english
question:
书面表达：话题写作。

请以「A Trip to Beijing」为题，写一篇短文描述你去北京的一次旅行。

要求：
1. 80-120词
2. 包括旅行时间、去的景点、做了什么、感受如何
3. 语句通顺，意思连贯
answer:
A Trip to Beijing

Last summer holiday, I went to Beijing with my parents. It was an unforgettable trip.

We stayed there for five days. On the first day, we visited the Great Wall. It was very long and great. I felt very proud of our country. On the second day, we went to the Palace Museum. I saw many old and beautiful things there. We also visited the Summer Palace and went boating on the lake. The most exciting thing was eating Peking duck. It was so delicious!

I had a wonderful time in Beijing. I hope I can go there again.
analysis:
【考点】考查游记类写作（一般过去时）
【解题思路】交代背景（时间/人物）→按时间顺序描写行程→表达感受
【解题口诀】👉 游记用过去时，按天描写有条理
core_trap: 学生容易时态混乱，在游记中混用现在时
mnemonic: 游记全用过去时，by the way说感受

subject: english
question:
书面表达：话题写作。

请以「The Importance of Reading」为题，写一篇短文。

要求：
1. 80-120词
2. 包括阅读的好处和你个人的阅读习惯
3. 语句通顺，意思连贯
answer:
The Importance of Reading

Reading is very important in our daily life. As the saying goes, books are the ladder of human progress.

First, reading can help us learn a lot of knowledge that we cannot get from textbooks. Second, reading can improve our writing skills because we can learn many good words and sentences from books. Third, reading is a good way to relax. When we feel tired, reading a good book can make us happy.

I usually read for half an hour before going to bed every day. My favorite books are about history and science. Let us read more books and become better ourselves.
analysis:
【考点】考查议论文式话题写作
【解题思路】引出话题（引用名言加分）→分条论述好处→结合个人实际→总结号召
【解题口诀】👉 议论文结构：观点→论据→个人实践→总结
core_trap: 学生论据太空泛，没有结合个人实际
mnemonic: 议论文要具体，个人经历更有力

subject: english
question:
书面表达：话题写作。

请以「How to Protect the Environment」为题，写一篇短文。

要求：
1. 80-120词
2. 包括当前环境问题及保护环境的建议
3. 语句通顺，意思连贯
answer:
How to Protect the Environment

The environment around us is getting worse and worse. There is more pollution, less clean water, and many animals are losing their homes. We must do something to protect the earth.

Here are some things we can do. First, we should not throw rubbish everywhere. We should sort the garbage and recycle things like paper and bottles. Second, we should ride bikes or take buses instead of driving cars to reduce air pollution. Third, we can plant more trees and use less plastic bags.

Protecting the environment is everyone's duty. If everyone does a little, our world will become much more beautiful.
analysis:
【考点】考查环保话题写作+should/not句型
【解题思路】描述问题→提出建议（First/Second/Third）→发出号召
【解题口诀】👉 环保作文结构：问题→建议→号召，三段式最稳妥
core_trap: 学生容易只提建议不描述问题，文章缺乏完整性
mnemonic: 环保作文三步走，先说问题再出招

subject: english
question:
书面表达：话题写作。

请以「A Meaningful Volunteer Activity」为题，写一篇短文描述你参加过的一次有意义的志愿活动。

要求：
1. 80-120词
2. 包括活动时间、地点、内容和你的感受
3. 语句通顺，意思连贯
answer:
A Meaningful Volunteer Activity

Last Saturday, I took part in a volunteer activity organized by our school. We went to a nursing home near our school to visit the old people.

When we arrived, we gave the old people some fruits and flowers. Then we cleaned their rooms and washed the windows. After that, some students chatted with them and listened to their stories, while others sang songs and danced for them. The old people were very happy and some of them even cried with joy.

I felt very tired but also very proud of myself. This activity taught me that helping others is the greatest happiness. I will take part in more volunteer activities in the future.
analysis:
【考点】考查叙事类话题写作（一般过去时）+志愿活动主题
【解题思路】交代背景（时间/人物/地点）→按时间顺序描写活动过程→表达感受和感悟。全文主要用一般过去时。while引导并列句表示同时。
【解题口诀】👉 叙事作文三步走：交代背景→描述经过→总结感悟
core_trap: 学生容易时态混乱，在叙事中混入现在时；或只罗列做了什么，缺少感悟
mnemonic: 叙事全用过去时，结尾感悟现在时
